description: Worked example only. Shows conditional rules, unknown handling, numeric zero and explicit false.

questions.label: Match
questions.prompt: Which match was this (for example Q42)?
questions.guidance: Explicit match label, for example Q42. Never infer from receive time.

questions.label: Team number
questions.prompt: Which team number were you scouting?
questions.guidance: Positive FRC team number. Do not confuse match number with team number.

questions.label: Robot status
questions.prompt: Did the robot play, break down or not show up?
questions.guidance: played if the robot competed normally; disabled if it stopped working during the match; no_show if it was not on the field.

questions.label: Auto pieces scored
questions.prompt: How many game pieces did the robot score in auto?
questions.guidance: Count of pieces scored in autonomous. 0 only when the scout says none were scored; null when not mentioned.

questions.label: Climbed
questions.prompt: Did the robot complete a climb?
questions.guidance: true for a completed climb. false only for an explicit failure or no climb. Missing mention is null.

questions.label: Climb level
questions.prompt: Which level did the robot climb to?
questions.guidance: The level the robot finished on. null if not stated.

questions.label: Played defence
questions.guidance: true if it played defence, false only if the scout says it did not. Missing mention is null.

questions.label: Defence notes
questions.guidance: The scout's description of the defence played.

questions.label: Cycle speed
questions.prompt: How fast were its scoring cycles: slow, average or fast?
questions.guidance: The scout's judgement of cycle speed.

questions.label: Notes
questions.guidance: Other observations in the scout's own words.
